jsonld.name: AnyLopez IPL Hair Removal
jsonld.description: Intense Pulsed Light (IPL) hair removal at AnyLopez Aesthetic Clinic Benidorm. Clinical-grade equipment, prior skin phototype assessment and a session plan based on your real hair growth cycle.

faq.q: How many sessions will I need?
faq.a: Between 6 and 10 sessions, spaced according to the area and hair growth cycle. Face and underarms: every 4-6 weeks. Legs and body: every 6-8 weeks. A one-off top-up once a year after completing the plan.
A brief snapping sensation with each light pulse. Far more comfortable than hot wax or diode laser. Most people don't need any anaesthetic.

faq.q: Can I have IPL in summer?
faq.a: Ideally IPL is done outside periods of intense sun exposure. Summer is fine if your skin isn't tanned and you use strict sunscreen. For tanned skin it's better to wait until autumn or winter.
IPL isn't validated for pregnancy or breastfeeding as a precaution, even though there is no evidence of harm. We wait until breastfeeding ends before starting a plan.

Both reduce hair permanently. IPL uses broad-spectrum pulsed light (more flexible across different areas and skin types). Diode laser uses a single coherent wavelength (more effective on very dark hair and fair skin, but less versatile).

hero.h1_html: Serious IPL hair removal. Not the high-street version.
hero.lead_html: Wax, razors, creams... you've spent years on temporary hair removal that piles up costs and damaged skin. IPL done properly reduces hair permanently — but only when it's done properly. Clinical-grade equipment and a plan tailored to your skin phototype and real hair growth cycle, not a one-size-fits-all low-cost chain protocol.

pain.h2: Most patients who come to us have been through the same thing.
pain.p_html: You're not arriving from nowhere. You're arriving after trying other things that didn't quite work.

items.h3_html: You're tired of shaving, waxing and depilatory creams
items.p_html: And your damaged skin shows it. Folliculitis, ingrown hairs, constant irritation. Your skin is asking for something permanent.

items.h3_html: You've tried IPL at low-cost chains with no lasting results
items.p_html: Cheap machines, fixed parameters, "come back every fortnight" — and then the hair grows back just the same. Technology without judgement doesn't work.

items.h3_html: You have sensitive skin, fine or fair hair, or a high phototype
items.p_html: And you're not sure if it'll work. The short answer: with professional equipment and a prior assessment, yes — with a generic device, no.

why.h2_html: Six reasons it works here when it hasn't worked elsewhere.
why.p_html: It's not marketing. It's clinical-grade equipment, prior assessment and case-by-case judgement.

items.p_html: Not an Amazon or bargain-bin device. Professional technology with adjustable parameters — the difference between actually reducing hair and not.

items.h3: Prior assessment of phototype and hair
items.p_html: Fair skin with dark hair responds differently to darker skin with fine hair. No assessment, poor outcome. With assessment, an effective plan.

items.h3: Sessions spaced to your real hair growth cycle
items.p_html: Not "come back every fortnight" to rack up sessions — but respecting the anagen phase of the hair (the only one IPL works on). Each area has its own cadence.
A brief snapping sensation from the pulsed light. No needles, no hot wax, no ingrown hairs.

items.h3: Compatible with sensitive skin and all phototypes
items.p_html: With adapted parameters, IPL is safe on sensitive skin. For higher (darker) phototypes we use specific protocols.

items.h3: Applied by someone who can read your skin
items.p_html: Decades of experience tuning parameters case by case. The difference between effective IPL and a placebo.

xsell.p: After an IPL protocol, your skin feels softer and more receptive — the perfect moment to add facials or restorative massages as part of your overall maintenance.

process.h2: Four steps. No surprises, no small print.
process.p: From your first message to your first session takes less than two weeks.

steps.p_html: A call or WhatsApp to find a slot. 30 minutes at the clinic, free of charge, no commitment.

We evaluate your skin colour, the colour and thickness of your hair, your medical history and the target area. We'll tell you honestly whether IPL is right for you — and if it isn't, we'll say so too.

steps.h3_html: Session plan based on area and cycle
steps.p_html: We design a realistic number of sessions and a cadence that respects each area's hair growth cycle. Face and underarms: 4-6 weeks. Legs and body: 6-8 weeks.
After the initial plan, a single top-up session once a year is enough. No endless commitments.
